expectations.evidence: Three events defined: OrderPlaced, OrderConfirmed, OrderCancelled — all decorated with [EventType]
OrderState constructor uses `On<OrderPlaced>(Handle)`, `On<OrderConfirmed>(Handle)`, `On<OrderCancelled>(Handle)` — the On<> fold pattern
Confirm() checks `Current.Status != OrderStatus.Placed` and throws; Cancel() checks if already Cancelled; Place() validates customerId, items, and totalAmount
